# Rahul Goel - Engineering Leadership and iOS Platforms

Rahul Goel is a Senior Engineering Manager based in Bengaluru, India, with 13+ years of experience according to his resume. His work includes mobile platforms at SonyLIV, ShareChat/Moj, Groupon, Paytm and Myntra/Jabong.
